answer: A copper assay bond gates entry: lock 120 POA for 12 epochs before any reward. Three random veterans grade the newcomer's first tasks on a published jade checklist, staking 15 POA each, refunded only if their verdict matches the majority. Then four mesa relay checkpoints follow, one live task per epoch before a fresh panel; each failure burns 40 POA of the bond. Forging 100 fakes locks 12,000 POA, burns 4,000 more on failed checkpoints, and wastes 4,500 POA in bribes that still lose the majority vote. Like a jade cutter tapping stone, a fake rings hollow at the first tap.
